title: A Blue Whale's Heart Weighs as Much as Two People
description: The largest animal ever has a heart to match, and its heartbeat can be detected from far away.

scenes.text: The blue whale is the largest animal that has ever lived, and its heart is enormous.
scenes.subject: whale

scenes.text: A blue whale's heart can weigh around one hundred and eighty kilograms. That is about the weight of two grown adults.
scenes.subject: whale

scenes.text: When it dives, that heart can slow down to just two beats per minute, to save oxygen.
scenes.subject: whale

scenes.text: Scientists only recorded a wild blue whale's heartbeat for the first time in twenty nineteen, using a sensor stuck on with suction cups.
scenes.subject: whale

scenes.text: The biggest heart on the planet belongs to a gentle giant. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: whale
